newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa promotes internet cargo page.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa promotes internet cargo page.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG said its new Internet home page will be primarily an information service for the air cargo industry.
The airline's business development manager, Michael Kraus, said the Lufthansa Cargo service offered smaller freight forwarders new information and communications opportunities.
These included Lufthansa Cargo product and services information as well as updated flight information and tracking and tracing functions through a direct link to the Traxon system.
Kraus said in a statement: "The main points are clearly on information services, while functions such as bookings are not yet possible primarily due to missing authorisation mechanisms."
He added: "This is not a problem, however, since Lufthansa Cargo with other airlines and forwarders offers the leading cargo system Traxon for sales operations."

Kraus said at a Lufthansa Cargo Internet presentation on October 10 that the airline could start direct bookings next year once security problems had been solved. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
